period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own annual-report-embedded 'Audit Committee and the Board Evaluation of the Quarterly Financials' table (a BSEC corporate-governance-mandated disclosure). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 of the same year (the source table's own column header reads '01 Jan to <quarter-end date>'), not discrete-quarter figures, flagged via the _cumulative suffix; balance-sheet items are the period-end snapshot. BASIS MISMATCH FLAGGED: this table's own text states the Board approved the CONSOLIDATED financial statements for quarterly disclosure every year it appears (2018, 2020-2025) — this differs from Trust Bank's main Q4/annual series in this dataset, which is SOLO (Bank-only, unconsolidated) basis for balance-sheet/income-statement items (see sources.json top-level reporting_basis, confirmed 2026-08-26). Verified numerically for FY2019: this table's own Q4/full-year column reports Total Assets 296,453 (Consolidated) vs this dataset's SOLO-basis FY2019 Q4 Total Assets 294,892.13 — a 0.53% gap, consistent with Trust Bank's small subsidiaries (Trust Bank Investment Ltd, Trust Bank Securities Ltd, Trust Axiata Digital Ltd) being added net of intercompany eliminations on consolidation, not a data error. Do not directly mix these CONSOLIDATED Q1-Q3 figures with this bank's SOLO-basis Q4/annual figures without adjusting for this basis gap. Source document is a LATER annual report's comparative-year column for FY2019 (FY2019's own annual report does not contain usable data for this). FY2019's own annual report lacks this table (see above), so this quarter is sourced solely from the FY2020 report's comparative column — but independently corroborated: the FY2019 Q4 figures in that same column (Total Assets 296,453; Deposits 241,822; Loans and Advances 212,836) match the FY2019 annual report's own front-page 'Financial Highlights' EXACTLY, confirming the comparative column is reliable despite FY2019's own report's incomplete text extraction. Loans and advances and Fixed Assets for this specific quarter are single-source (no second report reaches back to FY2019 Q1-Q3) — moderate confidence; all other line items shown are corroborated as above.
